thread:
Jenna (CS): Heads-up — Skyline DataOps pinged this morning: their new "Analytics Insights" team wants to onboard next month and needs dedicated embedding capacity plus lower-latency reranking for short-query flows. They mentioned a canary Dedicated pool. Possible expansion/upsell, but also a renewal hinge if we don't hit the SLA. @Luis can you own pricing/commit proposal?

Luis (AE): On it. Do we have usage numbers? Their current shared quota is hitting ~95% of throughput cap during peak windows.

ticket-bot: Ticket CS-8427 created (linked to account: skyline-dataops).

Jenna (CS): CS reported a 2x spike in peak QPS last week; rerank latency ~3s avg on short queries. They specifically asked: "can we run a 2-week canary on Dedicated and measure tail latency?" @Sam (SRE) any chance to spin up a small reserved pool in eu-west-1 for the canary? Also they'll need peering for private endpoints.

Sam (SRE): We can provision a 2xA10G pool in eu-west-1 for a short canary next week. Need expected QPS, avg tokens per request, and KV cache hit assumptions. Note: private peering needs infra ticket + CORS/network approvals — that'll add ~3 business days.

Matt (DevEx): I'll draft a QuickStart and troubleshooting playbook. Suggest we lock model versions for the canary and attach a small eval set to watch quality regressions. Snippet I can include in docs:
```
# quick curl example for canary route
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \n  -d '{"model":"x-embed-2000-dedicated-canary","input":"..."}'
```

Luis (AE): I'll put together a 6-month commitment proposal: +20% committed capacity, with a 2-week canary and a health-check milestone. If they sign, we can lock renewal at current rates (renewal in ~3 months). Jenna — can you confirm stakeholders and any compliance asks from them?

Jenna (CS): Yes — I'll run an enablement session for their new team next Tues and collect feature owners. Actions: @Sam provision canary by Mon (request infra ticket for peering), @Matt docs by Thu, @Luis draft commit and pricing by EOD Wed. I'll attach Loom + CS notes to CS-8427. :thumbsup:

Sam (SRE): Ack — starting the infra request now, will update ticket with ETA.

Luis (AE): Thanks — prepping draft. If they need a private deployment later, call it out early so we don't bottleneck networking.

Jenna (CS): Perfect. I'll also capture a short eval suite so DevEx can wire alerts into Console (quality/regression).
